title: Govt extends new ESIC amnesty scheme by three months till December 31
description:
The Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) has extended the New Amnesty Scheme, 2025, for three months till December 31, 2026, giving employers and insured persons more time to resolve pending cases, a labour ministry statement said.
Post review of representations from various stakeholders, the Employees' State Insurance Corporation has extended the 'New Amnesty Scheme, 2025' which ran from October 1, 2025, to September 30, 2026, for a further period of three months -- from October 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026 -- on existing terms and conditions, the statement said.
The 'New Amnesty Scheme 2025' is a one-time dispute resolution initiative aimed at reducing the backlog of court cases and promoting compliance under the erstwhile ESI Act.
It provides a structured mechanism for employers to resolve legal disputes with ESIC for an out-of-court settlement.
The scheme allows settlement of ad-hoc assessments by paying actual contributions and interest, without damages being levied,
